note: No authored grammar can provoke this pass today, so this directory carries no grammar.xml or words.yaml. Recorded as data rather than prose so it is not mistaken for an oversight. Verified against the code on the branch this fixture was authored on: PartnerPairingPass consumes only explicit LocalEvent::PartnerOpen/PartnerClose facts (rust/crates/pg-foma/src/candidate_filter/model.rs, LocalEvent), and a circumfix reaches pg-foma as ONE AffixAllomorphDef with one flat rhs (rust/crates/pg-grammar/src/model.rs), classified by one whole-allomorph Role::CircumfixPrefix (rust/crates/pg-foma/src/emit.rs, classify_affix) and emitted as one morpheme tag with one surface. No half identity survives compilation, so no producer can derive two partner-linked trace units from an authored grammar. Two refinements found while checking: (1) the Rust FieldWorks compile path does not cross-product a circumfix at all, it skips the entry with a warning (rust/crates/pg-grammar/src/compile/affixes.rs), so the halves lose identity by a different route there; (2) pg-rules' confirm engine does emit one MorphRecord per contiguous run, so a circumfix's two pieces are separately recorded there, but both runs carry the same allomorph and morpheme ids and nothing maps them into LocalEvent -- that is a fact about future feasibility on the generator side, not about today.
